note: Private ranch and event center just N of Fort Dodge, with the CreekSide restaurant, event halls and rooms to rent; the RV rows sit in open lawn by the road (the operator lost its ash trees and is replanting). In winter campers must fully insulate the water spigot, and freeze repairs are at their cost. ATV and hiking trails to Lizard Creek; near Dolliver Memorial SP. Takes long-term campers. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25/night ($155/wk, $600/mo), 48 full-hookup 30/50A sites, year-round, tag-and-pay. Gate passes ($25, no gateway needed), presence passes. All five long-stay tests pass, though it leans long-term. Ratings: Google 4.6 (192, whole business), RV Life 4 stars (3), Dyrt 5.0. Keep.
flags: GATE FACTS: posted rate $25 a night on the operator's own page (also $155/week, $600/month); no Good Sam; gateways.py: none within 40 km (not needed at $25); presence: working website with phone (515) 890-3758, Google listing 'Lizard Creek Ranch' open with 192 reviews.

RATINGS: Google 'Lizard Creek Ranch' 4.6 from 192 reviews (the whole business: restaurant, event halls, lodging, campground); a separate Google pin 'Lizard Creek Ranch Campground' shows no rating. RV Life 4 stars (8/10) on 3 reviews (10/2026 motorhome $25, 8/2024 $25, 10/2023 $19). The Dyrt 5.00 (review count not read on the page). Campendium: no listing found. Yelp refused (403), not read. Nothing under 4.0 with 25+ reviews.

LONG-STAY: (1) price $25 passes; (2) nightly rate on its own site with a phone and no approval, pass; (3) no minimum, pass; (4) no nightly/monthly split is published and all 47 sites are sold tag-and-pay by the day, pass; (5) an RV park, no homes or lots sold, pass. Leaning long-term, quoted: 'Lot rent is due upon arrival or on the 1st of every Month. (Long Term)', 'If payment has not been received by the 2nd Monday of the month, all utilities will be locked out', 'Long term rentals welcome', plus rooms in three cottages rented 'nightly to monthly' ($550-750/month). RV Life 10/2026: 'we expected it to be fairly empty at the end of October. Instead, there were only a few spaces open.' NAIP shows the rows nearly full. I read it as a mixed transient/long-term park, not shown to be mostly seasonal, and not borderline on price or reviews: keep.

EVENTS: the question was whether it is bookable only around events. It is not: the camping page sells ordinary nights all year ('SITES OPEN ALL YEAR', '47 tag and pay RV sites') and RV Life reviewers stayed as ordinary transients.
SITES: the operator's pages disagree: 48 (camping page), 47 (home page), 60 (about page). Written 48 from the camping page.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. On NAIP the RV rows (centre ~42.53658,-94.25478) are in open lawn by the county road with no water nearby; the creek is off-site.
PIN: stored 42.53565,-94.25543 is at the parking lot south of the RV rows, ~115 m from their centre; under the 250 m line, so not corrected.
